about: Procurement's own fact kinds. This vertical carries the project's only period-keyed carry-forward (`p2p.open_shortfall_*`), so it is where `carries-forward-as(derive)` is a measured fact rather than a design intention. `financial.accrual.grni` is registered here, not by retail, despite the prefix: the procurement cycle mints it and answers for it.

fact_kinds.about: The contracted unit rate.
Who the contract is with.
The match tolerance, in per cent.
The tolerance in currency at this order's size.
What was committed.
Quantity times rate, exactly.
What arrived.
What arrived, valued at contract.
What was billed.
The billed unit price the match disputes.
Billed quantity times billed price.
The price leg of the failed match.
The quantity leg of the failed match.
The two legs, summed — `_checks` recomputes the accrual arithmetic.
The exception's state chain; exactly one status is open at a time.
Who approved paying over the tolerance.
What was actually paid.
The credit note that settles the price leg.
The vendor-master change request's state chain.
Undelivered quantity at close; next month's is derived from it.
Undelivered value at close — the balance the accrual carries.
Prior shortfall cleared by this month's receipts.
The released balance, valued.
Goods-received-not-invoiced accrual the close books.
Third-party spend receipted in the period, at contracted rates — by division, by spend category, and by the depots that took delivery.
fact_kinds.note: The estate's three, and the reason each carries `sums-to` against itself: like retail's `financial.revenue.actual`, one kind is stated at four levels — group, division, spend category or site, and (for commitment) cost centre — and the roll-up is between facts of the same kind rather than between two kinds.

fact_kinds.about: Purchase-order commitment placed and not yet received at close — by division, by depot and project office, and by the cost centre it is coded to. Doubles as the commitment movement's closing balance: next period's p2p.commitment.opening is resolved from it.
The order book brought forward at the period's open — the previous close's p2p.open_commitment, restated so one period's record carries its whole movement. The first period on record draws it.
fact_kinds.note: The movement's two other legs. Two kinds, not four: the closing balance is `p2p.open_commitment` and the received leg is `p2p.third_party_spend` — each already registered to mean exactly that — and a `p2p.commitment.closing` or `p2p.commitment.received` stating the same figures under new names would be the copy-that-can-drift this corpus refuses at every level.

fact_kinds.about: Purchase-order value placed in the period — the movement's inflow. Closing less opening plus receipts, exactly; `stockflow.verify` recomputes it.
Materials held in the yards at close. Only a yard holds any: the archetype gives one no revenue weight for exactly that reason.
